bills.title: Minimum Nursing Staff Levels In Hospitals
Chld Sex Abuse Mat; Gen Images; Soc Media

reading.body:
Alaska's tracked 2025 legislative session produced 13 bills flagged in this dataset, but only a handful directly address artificial intelligence: SB2 covers AI, deepfakes, cybersecurity, and data transfers, SB33 addresses synthetic media liability in elections, and HCR3 would create an AI legislative task force.

The rest of the list, bills on election procedures, nursing staff minimums, the state operating budget, and definitions of personhood, shows the practical difficulty of tracking AI legislation by keyword or topic tagging. Many bills that touch loosely adjacent territory, or share a sponsor or committee with AI bills, get swept into a state's AI bill list even when their primary subject is unrelated.

Three bills, HB47, SB262, and HB318, concern child sexual abuse material, generated images, and social media use by minors, a legislative area that increasingly overlaps with AI concerns about synthetic and AI generated content targeting children, even where the bill's core focus is social media rather than AI specifically.

The data does not indicate which of these 13 bills have passed, failed, or remain pending, nor does it include bill text or sponsor information beyond title and number, so the current legislative status of Alaska's AI adjacent bills is not established by this record.
